code_prompt_defaults.object_description_compact_board: a 6 by 6 Reversi board with black and white discs

code_prompt_defaults.legal_move_rule_text: A legal move is an empty square that brackets one or more opponent discs in at least one straight line.
code_prompt_defaults.corner_rule_text: The corner squares are the four outermost corners.
code_prompt_defaults.marked_move_rule_text: The red marked empty square is the marked move.
code_prompt_defaults.flip_rule_text: The marked move flips every bracketed opponent disc.
code_prompt_defaults.frontier_rule_text: A frontier disc touches at least one empty square horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
